# mapbox styles

Mapbox Styles API

The Mapbox Styles API lets you read and change map styles, fonts, and images. Map styles are JSON documents that conform to the Mapbox Style Specification.

8 commands. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox styles create

Create a style

Add a new style to an account. The server automatically generates the
`created`, `id`, `modified`, and `owner` fields. Glyph and sprite
endpoints are overwritten unless Mapbox defaults are used.

If `name` is omitted, it defaults to the style ID. The style must be
valid JSON conforming to the Mapbox Style Specification — invalid styles
return a 422.

`POST https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `--data DATA` `-d` | yes | string |  | Request body as a JSON string, or `@<path>` to read a file and `@-` to read stdin. Sent in the request body. Sent as `application/json`. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox styles create --username USERNAME --data '{}'
```

### mapbox styles delete

Delete a style

Remove a style and all associated sprites permanently.
Deleted styles can be restored within 30 days via the restore endpoint.

`DELETE https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox styles delete --username USERNAME STYLE_ID
```

### mapbox styles draft delete

Delete a style draft

Deletes only the draft version of a style, reverting it to the published
version. The published style is not affected.

`DELETE https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/draft`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox styles draft delete --username USERNAME STYLE_ID
```

### mapbox styles draft get

Retrieve a style draft

Returns the draft version of a style. Each style maintains separate
published and draft versions — Mapbox Studio always edits the draft.
If no draft exists, the published style is returned.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/draft`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox styles draft get --username USERNAME STYLE_ID
```

### mapbox styles draft update

Update a style draft

Updates the draft version of a style. If no draft exists, one is created
from the published version. Draft changes do not affect the published
version automatically.

`PATCH https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/draft`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `data` | `--data DATA` `-d` | yes | string |  | Request body as a JSON string, or `@<path>` to read a file and `@-` to read stdin. Sent in the request body. Sent as `application/json`. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox styles draft update --username USERNAME STYLE_ID --data '{}'
```

### mapbox styles get

Retrieve a style

Obtain a style document in JSON format conforming to the Mapbox Style Specification.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `download` | `--download` | no | boolean |  | When present, returns the style as a downloadable JSON file attachment. Sent in the request query. |
| `optimize` | `--optimize` | no | boolean |  | When `true`, rewrites vector source URLs for cache optimization. Sent in the request query. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox styles get --username USERNAME STYLE_ID
```

### mapbox styles list

List styles

Retrieve metadata for all styles in an account, with pagination support.

Supports pagination via `limit` and `start` query parameters. Use the
`Link` response header to retrieve subsequent pages.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deleted` | `--deleted` | no | boolean |  | When `true`, returns recently deleted styles instead of active ones. Sent in the request query. |
| `draft` | `--draft` | no | boolean |  | When present, includes draft styles in the listing. Sent in the request query. |
| `limit` | `--limit LIMIT` | no | integer |  | Maximum number of styles to return. Sent in the request query. |
| `start` | `--start START` | no | string |  | Style ID to use as a pagination cursor (exclusive). Sent in the request query. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

To fetch one of the things this returns, see `mapbox styles get`.

```sh
mapbox styles list --username USERNAME
```

### mapbox styles update

Update a style

Modify an existing style. The `name` property is required. Remove
`created` and `modified` fields before submitting — including them
returns a 422. Glyph and sprite endpoints are overwritten the same
way as on creation. Cross-version updates (e.g. v7 to v8) are rejected.

`PATCH https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `data` | `--data DATA` `-d` | yes | string |  | Request body as a JSON string, or `@<path>` to read a file and `@-` to read stdin. Sent in the request body. Sent as `application/json`. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox styles update --username USERNAME STYLE_ID --data '{}'
```
